subject: Re: Next steps & intro to economic buyer - Orion Systems
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@orion-systems.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps & intro to economic buyer - Orion Systems

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Summary: You’re evaluating a hosted inference solution for customer-facing features (search & summarization) across your SaaS product. Primary drivers: latency SLOs for 95th pct, predictable unit cost, and data residency controls for EU customers.
- Technical fit: our Dedicated pools + smart routing would cover the throughput profile you described; Redwood Optimize could help reduce token cost for batch jobs.
- Open items we agreed to close next:
  1) Intro to the economic buyer / budget owner so we can align on TCO and procurement cadence.
  2) Procurement & security checklist (SOC2/ISO evidence) — any preferred format?
  3) A concise mutual action plan + timeline for a pilot.

Could you please introduce me to the budget owner (either by forwarding this thread or loop them in)? If it helps, here’s a one-line you can paste: “Marissa Cole from Redwood Inference — we ran through integration approach and pilot scope; can you share budget clarity and procurement timeline?”

I’ve attached a short discovery recap and our standard checklist for procurement.

Thanks — enjoy the rest of your week.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

Attachments: Discovery_Recap-Marissa-20261228.docx

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@orion-systems.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orion-systems.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps & intro to economic buyer - Orion Systems

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the tidy recap — exactly right. Looping in Liam O'Connor (VP, Finance) who owns budget decisions for platform investments like this. Liam — meet Marissa from Redwood; she led our discovery and has the pilot scope.

A couple quick notes for context for Liam:
- We’ve earmarked headroom in the Q1 ops budget but need a clearer unit-cost model and pilot success metrics to finalize.
- Procurement/security will want SOC2, data retention and IP clauses reviewed. I’ve attached Orion’s standard RFP template — procurement will push the timeline a bit depending on redlines.

Liam — would you be available for a 30-minute conversation week of Jan 4 to review budget and procurement timing?

Thanks,
Aisha
Director, Product Partnerships | Orion Systems
Aisha.patel@orion-systems.com

Attachments: Orion_RFP_Q4-2026.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orion-systems.com>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@orion-systems.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps & intro to economic buyer - Orion Systems

Liam — great to meet you via email. Short note on what I propose for the intro call:

1) 15–30 min alignment: walk through pilot scope, success metrics, and expected unit economics (we’ll bring a ballpark TCO for Dedicated vs Hosted).
2) Procurement expectations: we’ll share SOC2 evidence, typical contract timeline, and a suggested mutual action plan.
3) Decision criteria check: performance (95p latency), cost, and data residency — are there any other non-negotiables?

Rishi (cc): can you draft a 2-slide pricing snapshot (pilot vs 12-month commitment) and a short note on typical procurement cadence we can show Liam?
Vivek (cc): can you confirm availability to join the Jan 5 call if we need any technical/arch context?

Proposed times: Tue Jan 5 at 10:00am PT or Wed Jan 6 at 9:00am PT. Which works best?

Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps & intro to economic buyer - Orion Systems

On it — will put together the pricing snapshot and procurement note. Draft plan:

- Pricing snapshot: Pilot (4 weeks): estimated committed throughput, expected average token/unit cost, and a pilot credit ask.
- 12-month committed option: tiered pricing with Dedicated baseline + burst credits and optional Optimize credits.
- Procurement note: SOC2/ISO attachments we can share, typical SOW cadence, and examples of enterprise contract redlines we’ve accepted previously.

I’ll send drafts by EOD Dec 31 so you have them for the Jan 5 meeting. Vivek — I may ping you for a short architecture diagram.

Thanks,
Rishi
Enterprise Account Director | Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orion-systems.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@orion-systems.com>
Cc: procurement@orion-systems.com
Date: Mon, 03 Jan 2027 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps & intro to economic buyer - Orion Systems

Hi Marissa & Aisha —

Thanks for the intro. Jan 5 at 10:00am PT works for me. I’ve asked procurement to review the RFP ahead of time; they may have a couple of baseline questions but nothing unusual.

A couple items I want to cover on the call:
- High-level TCO comparison (pilot vs committed) and any runway assumptions.
- How Redwood supports predictable billing and overruns (alerts/quotas).
- Data controls for EU residents — we have a material number of EU customers and need assurance on residency and KMS.

Looking forward to the overview. If you can share the pricing snapshot + SOC2 evidence before end-of-day Jan 4 that would be ideal.

Regards,
Liam O'Connor
VP, Finance | Orion Systems
liam.oconnor@orion-systems.com
